title: Chronos Ingestion Contract v1
description: The canonical intermediate JSON that a source parser (.docx class / lab / faculty timetables, classrooms.xlsx) emits and that the database seeder consumes. It is a faithful record of what was observed in one source file, including its data-quality defects: nothing is silently repaired, every defect is reported in `anomalies`. Frozen contract 1 of 3 (CONTEXT.md section 5) - changing it requires agreement from all three track owners.

schema_version.description: Identifier of this contract revision. Pinned so a consumer can refuse a payload written against a different revision.

source_file.description: Basename of the source document this payload was parsed from, e.g. 'CE_Class_Time_Table-EVEN_sem_25-26.docx'.

semester.description: The academic term the source file covers.

code.description: ODD (semesters III, V, VII) or EVEN (IV, VI, VIII).

academic_year.description: Academic year as printed on the source, e.g. '2025-26'.

departments.description: Departments referenced by this file. Rooms are institute-level and are deliberately NOT scoped to a department (CONTEXT.md section 2, rule 5).

code.description: Short department code as used in the timetables, e.g. 'CE', 'CSE', 'EXTC'.

programmes.description: Degree programmes offered by a department.

semester_number.description: Semester ordinal within the programme: 3..8 for B.Tech, 1..2 for M.Tech.

label.description: Label exactly as printed, e.g. 'SE-Comp A', 'TE-Comp C', 'BE-Comp A', 'M.Tech Comp'.

strength.description: Student count, or null when the source does not state it.

batches.description: Lab batches within a division, normally four (A-D).

label.description: Batch letter as printed in a lab cell, 'A'..'D'.

rooms.description: Physical rooms from classrooms.xlsx. Institute-level: a room is not owned by a department.

code.description: Room code exactly as printed, e.g. '002', '702', '509 new CSE'.

room_type.description: Derived from the 'used as' column. 'unknown' preserves an unusable value (rooms 605 and 609 read 'unsure') rather than guessing - see anomaly UNKNOWN_ROOM_USAGE.

separation.description: Raw value of the separation column, e.g. '20-20-20' for room 603. null when the room is not separable.

sub_rooms.description: Sub-rooms derived from `separation`. Naming is inconsistent in the source - both letters ('702-A') and digits ('603-2') occur - and is preserved verbatim.

faculty.description: Faculty members, one per page of the faculty individual timetable.

department_id.description: Owning department. Faculty remain schedulable institute-wide.

initials.description: Initials as used in class-timetable cells ('KKD', 'AGN', 'PBB'). null when the initials-to-name mapping could not be resolved - see anomaly UNRESOLVED_FACULTY_INITIALS.

theory_hours.description: Theory hours taken from the '6T+ 8P =14' workload line. null when that line is absent - see anomaly MISSING_WORKLOAD.

practical_hours.description: Practical hours from the same workload line. Load balancing and substitution ordering use the theory/practical split, never a raw session count.

total_hours.description: Total as printed. Kept separate from theory+practical so an arithmetic error in the source stays visible instead of being silently corrected.

subjects.description: Subjects referenced by any cell in the source.

code.description: Subject code as printed in cells, e.g. 'OS', 'DAA', 'CCN', 'PCS'.

session_type.description: 'both' when the subject has a theory component and a lab component.

qualifications.description: Faculty-subject competence, many-to-many. Drives substitution during live rescheduling. 'observed' was inferred from a timetable cell; 'declared' came from an authoritative allocation list.

cohorts.description: The polymorphic student group a session is taught to - the constituency the solver treats as one vertex.

cohort_type.description: 'division' = a whole division; 'batch' = one lab batch; 'elective' = a cross-division elective group; 'combined' = two or more divisions taught together.

label.description: Label as printed, e.g. 'SE-Comp B', 'PE-I-D', 'PE-II-A', 'SE C & D'.

member_batch_ids.description: Full expansion of the cohort down to batches. Two cohorts clash exactly when these sets intersect, which is how COHORT edges are derived for the edge-list contract.

observed_sessions.description: One parsed timetable cell = one session as it was actually observed in the source. This is ground truth for validation, not solver output.

faculty_id.description: null when the cell named initials that could not be resolved to a faculty member.

room_id.description: null when the cell named no room, or named one absent from classrooms.xlsx.

sub_room_id.description: Set when the cell named a sub-room such as '702-A' or '603-2'; null when it named the whole room.

duration_periods.description: Number of consecutive teaching periods; 2 for the usual double lab period.

source_cell.description: The raw cell text, kept verbatim for traceability back to the document, e.g. 'OS / A / AGN / 702-A'.

lab_blocks.description: A lab slot holding N batch-parallel sessions of one division - four batches, four subjects, four faculty, four rooms - which must stay simultaneous and contiguous. Modelled as a block, never as N independent sessions.

parallel_session_ids.description: ids of the observed_sessions that run together in this block.

pinned_blocks.description: Immovable occupancy the solver may not schedule into: MDM, HSS, LLC, student activity, major project, exams and breaks.

label.description: Label as printed, e.g. 'MDM -I THEORY', 'HSS II', 'DAA LAB EXAM ESE SE COMP NR'.

cohort_id.description: The cohort held by this block, or null when it blocks the slot institute-wide (a break).

anomalies.description: Every data-quality defect found while parsing. The ingestion layer reports defects, it never repairs them (CONTEXT.md section 3.5). An empty array is a positive claim that the source was clean.

severity.description: 'error' means the affected record could not be produced; 'warning' means it was produced but is suspect.

code.description: Machine-readable defect class. This enum is the frozen minimum set; extending it is a contract revision.

message.description: Human-readable explanation in institutional terms, naming the room, faculty member or cohort involved.

source_cell.description: Raw cell text the defect was found in, or null for a file-level defect.

id.description: Stable string identifier, unique within its collection in this payload.

teaching_period.description: Teaching-slot index within a day, 0..7 - the eight schedulable hours of CONTEXT.md section 3.2, counted in teaching order with the two breaks excluded. The edge-list contract re-indexes these onto its wall-clock grid via slot_grid.teaching_periods.
